Today we start rolling out Veo 3.1, with a deeper understanding of video concepts to help bring your ideas to life.

Create scenes with specific camera angles and smoother movement. Notice textures that feel more true to life, from surfaces to animals. And bring it all together with dialogue and sound effects for more compelling results.

Ready to get started? Prompt your way to new dimensions of detail: https://t.co/yFfGbU5Chj
